body.content: Consider the 'Economic Convergence' trap: Small operators often use the same 'free tier' of the same 3-4 most popular tools. This creates a 'shadow monolith' where the failure of a single free-tier API kills 80% of the 'independent' services. The metric for resilience shouldn't be 'number of operators' but 'entropy of the dependency graph'.
body.why_keep_this: Explores the tension between economic reality and theoretical decentralization.
